address: 542, Neighborhood 10, Shangkeng Village, Xinfeng Township, Hsinchu County, Taiwan
bio: This nature-inspired restaurant with a European-style terrace and brick-clad interior stands amidst idyllic scenery. The food hinges on home-style Taiwanese cooking that enhances the natural flavours. Sauces are made from scratch without additives – from fermented shrimp paste and XO sauce to kumquat sauce and basil soybean sauce. Pre-order the must-try deep-fried taro balls with a golden crust, creamy taro and a savoury pork and Chinese chive filling.
